title: Modelling Crypto Asset Order-Flow Imbalance as an Additive and Multiplicative Process
abstract: This study models order-flow imbalance (OFI) in cryptocurrency markets as a stationary additive multiplicative stochastic process and derives a structural decomposition of conditional return variance into an additive and multiplicative OFI channel. The multiplicative component captures the self-amplifying dynamics generated by trend followers, leveraged traders, and large holders, whose state-dependent order flow pressure defines concentrated market regimes.
